notes.title: Demo is out!
notes.content:
Web Demo Live

We're excited to announce the launch of the Backrooms Fishing Demo! It's available directly in your browser (no download required) on itch.io today!

Demo Features
Explore the first two zones of eerie Poolrooms

Upgrade your fishing equipment and collect bizarre specimens

Complete quests and uncover the secrets of the Backrooms

Available Now

Play Demo in Browser

Happy Fishing!
